findings.message: This loads a module with a CommonJS `require` call. A `require` is an ordinary function call evaluated at runtime, so a missing module or a mistyped path is a crash when the line executes rather than an error the compiler reports, and a bundler cannot see through it to drop the parts of the module nothing uses. Scattered calls also hide what a file depends on, which an import list at the top makes plain. Use an `import` declaration, or `import()` where the load genuinely has to be deferred.
